messages:
alex: Heads-up: p95 latency for model xlit-13b jumped ~4x around 23:05 UTC. Spinning up thread.
maya: saw it on dashboards, looks like KV cache evictions spiked at same time.
siva: UX reported requests timing out, a few 504s, throughput dip on pool-gpu-1.
incident-bot: Incident created: PERF-1845 - p95 spike on xlit-13b (assigned: eng-runtime)
jordan: rolling kernel selector change landed earlier today (kernel-autopick v2). Could be related.
frank: I pulled a flameprof sample from one host, see big stall in matmul kernel selection.
frank: snippet:
```
flamegraph: slow path in select_kernel()
  select_kernel()  67%
  quant_compat_check()  12%
  fallback_to_fp16()  18%
```
luca: also saw KV cache eviction waterfall: many tenants evicting small prefixes -> increased cold starts.
harper: batch sizes also decreased, adaptive batching seems to be under-reacting to short sequences.
alex: hypothesis: kernel-autopick v2 + sudden KV eviction -> smaller batches + suboptimal kernel chosen -> p95 spike.
maya: agree. Proposed mitigation: flip kernel_autopick flag to v1, enable aggressive prefix caching, and throttle best-effort tenants for 15m.
siva: can we route traffic from pool-gpu-1 to pool-gpu-fallback (older kernels) while we rollback?
jordan: I'll open a routing override: `routectl set-policy --from pool-gpu-1 --to pool-gpu-fallback --match 'model=xlit-13b' --duration 15m`
frank: toggling feature flag: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/kernel_autopick -d '{"value":"v1","reason":"perf spike rollback"}'`
luca: enabling aggressive prefix caching: `config set runtime.kv_cache.prefix_retention=120s`
harper: starting throttling on best-effort tenants: `ratelimitctl set tenant_group=best-effort rate=150rps`
alex: I'm kicking off canary to confirm impact, monitoring p95 and eviction rate.
incident-bot: Action log: routing override applied by jordan, feature flag changed by frank, kv cache tweak by luca, throttling applied by harper.
frank: after changes p95 dropped ~30% in 2 minutes, evictions down, throughput recovering :thumbsup: 
maya: leaving flags as-is for now, monitoring for 30m, if stable we'll ship proper fix in kernel selector.
alex: next steps: perf team to add regression test covering small-batch kernel selection, add KV eviction telemetry per-tenant.
jordan: capturing thread notes in incident board.
incident-bot: Incident PERF-1845 status: monitoring, actions applied. last update 1845012410
